title: Understanding Percentiles
text: The 75th percentile is the value below which 75% of the data falls. In a violin plot, this is often represented by the upper edge of the box in the plot. Consider how this might look for different categories.

title: Comparing Violin Plots
text: When comparing violin plots, look at the spread and the position of the quartiles. The 75th percentile is higher if the upper part of the plot extends further up.

title: Analyzing the Violin Plot
